message: Ｈ・Ｅ・Ｒ・Ｏ！
Cooking the food to serve the guests and participants has finally calmed down a bit.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? It's about to start, so where did Lolotte run off to?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... What an idiot, right when it's finally time to sneak some snacks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, knock it off!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Preside~~nt!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, there you are. You scared me, disappearing all of a sudden like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The real surprise is still coming, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! Why are you transformed!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're just noticing now? Come on, we're short on time, so please transform already.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm asking why!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just hurry up and do it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop i~~t!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff... So, what are we gonna do...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In order to hype up the stage, we must do something hype-worthy. And so!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Starting right now, we're putting on a fun and exciting hero sho~~w!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I properly got permission to use the stage, you know. The scheduling is super-duper locked in too.」

name: Synn
message: 「When did you do that!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I decided on it just a moment ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about last-minute...」

name: Paqy
message: 「A hero show? What do I look like, a brat?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't go throwing a selfish tantrum when you can't even draw a crowd.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I ain't some sideshow attraction!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on now, everyone is waiting.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shiiin!! Over here, over here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. Even Nanaka transformed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because after all, I'm playing the idol--I mean, the hero!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's a herooo!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't let your voice crack!! Got a problem with it being me?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san and I are forming a unit to perform 'Futari wa Kuru-Kuru.'」

name: Synn
message: 「What does 'Kuru-Kuru' even stand for?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Cool Crusaders,' of course.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's coool!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Only me?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't there five Crusaders?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then that would make it 'Kuru-Kuru Five,' wouldn't it!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「More importantly, we're short-staffed, so that's rejected.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are the others doing?」

name: Ria
message: 「'Hiii, everyone! Hello!! Huuh? I can't hear you, one more time! Yeah, yeah, everyone's full of energy today~~♪'」

name: Synn
message: 「She kinda just looks like her usual self, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She is everyone's 'Big Sister,' an indispensable role for any hero show.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, 'Big Sister,' she says.\s04」
Still, this upperclassman is really getting into it.

name: Synn
message: 「Then all that's left is...」

name: Misa
message: 「Kumaa.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is Misa... I mean, Blackuma doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As for Blackuma, she is a foot soldier.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kumaa.」
I can't see her expression, but she's radiating an aura of pure negativity.

name: Synn
message: 「How did she end up like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because I can't serve as a hero looking like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just accept that!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And finally, the president.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thump-thump...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, I will have you become the evil Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? D-Demon Lord, whaaaat!?」
N-no way... Could it be that Lolotte realized I'm the Demon Lord and is doing this...!?

name: Ria
message: 「If you're a bad Demon Lord, I'll have to punish you good and proper.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Even you, Ria-senpai...!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright, President. It was only decided by process of elimination.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so? Good things come to those who take the leftovers, hm?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll apologize in advance. Sorry if I hurt you.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's what it is!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here is the script.」
I skim through it and drill it into my head. The Demon Lord is a classic, hammy villain laid on thick.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you already memorized yours?」

name: Misa
message: 「I only have one line...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, here's the synopsis. First, there were two close girls.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's who we are--the duo, Kurukuru!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That girl ends up falling in love with the same boy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, that Demon Lord was terribly wicked, and not only deceived the two of them, but even used them.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you're the worst.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it wasn't me.\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Realizing this, the two mend their friendship and defeat the evil Demon Lord.」

name: Ria
message: 「Where is Misa-chan's turn?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the role of getting caught up in the explosion there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's guaranteed to be a tearjerker of a story. Alright, shall we go all out with a bang!!」
The main event begins without even a moment to refuse.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can't forgive taking advantage of a maiden's heart.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But if you think something like that can ruin our friendship, you're dead wrong.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wisdom... Power... Courage... What good is any of it? What lies beyond them?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with the high-and-mighty attitude? Even though all you ever say is 'delicious'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Always brewing nothing but weak, over-steeped tea--such endless villainy. I simply cannot let this slide!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmmm... Even things that have nothing to do with the Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Fahahaha. Just watch. I'll destroy everything in this world!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I will never let that happen!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「On our name!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's go, Kurukuru Cyan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here we go, Kurukuru Pink.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hurry up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To the Demon World.」

name: Nanaka & Lolotte
message: 「Welcome home!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, everyone in the audience, cheer those two on!! Lend them your strength!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Go, Nana-chan! Don't lose.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the rear support to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can hear everyone's voices...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can hear their voices roaring and crying out to defeat evil!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Utterly pointless!! And utterly reckless!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Power is surging through me more and more. Everyone is lending us their strength!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Fwahahaha. Such things will never work on me, the Demon Lord--」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey...! That was a false start, wasn't it!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Striking first is the key to victory!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you ready for this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The two of us are in Kuru-Kuru Serious Moooode!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Impossible--!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now!!」

name: Lolotte & Nanaka
message: 「Goooo!! Kuru-Kuru Powerful Dynamic Special Gorgeous Sparkle Attaaack!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Beeeear!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gwaaaaaah!!」

name: Lolotte & Nanaka
message: 「This is the power of dreaming maidens.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Uboaaaargh!!」

name: Ria
message: 「And so, the peace of the world was protected♪ Everyone~, thank you for cheering us on~!! Please keep having lots and lo~ts of fun at the Meteor Kirakira Festival!!」
The hero show came to a close amid thunderous applause.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone! Great work out there!!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Great work~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things really do work out somehow--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm just so glad nobody got hurt.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the crowd was super hyped, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-um. Don't sweat it!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But thanks to that, look!! So many customers have gathered in the courtyard.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. A huge success, isn't it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you all very much for your cooperation.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehehe... Now then, I suppose I'll return to my post.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before that, I'll hand out the next script.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In the afternoon, we'll be performing 'Futari wa Kurukuru Massive Heart,' so I'm counting on everyone's best effort.」
Even in the new installment, the cast hadn't changed one bit.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Make sure you memorize it thoroughly, okay?\s04」
And once again, it ended with an explosion punchline.
